where: Trainer battles: every Lampwarden duel for a Gleam (Brisa, Reyl, Sable, Otho), the Beacon and route trainers, and Wren's first friendly bout
mood: The arena duel — proud, rousing and fair: a respected challenger in the lantern-light, the fight that earns a constellation.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor with a proud lift to F major
galloping plucked sampled bass in octaves
sampled marching snare rolls and tom fills with timpani hits on the accents, crash cymbal on phrase starts

sections.name: Challenge
sections.text: {a challenger steps forward: two bold brass hits, a snare roll, a fast rising pulse-wave run that lands on the downbeat of the duel theme}

sections.name: Duel Theme
sections.text: {the duel melody: a proud, strutting brass hook with swagger, pulse-wave runs filling the gaps, galloping octave bass underneath}

sections.name: Duel Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hook again, now on the pulse-wave lead with brass harmony underneath, the arpeggios busier, rising in intensity}

sections.name: Arena Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a proud lift to F major, broad sustained brass chords like a cheering crowd under lantern-light, the lead soaring higher, tom fills building the tension back}

sections.name: Duel Theme Return
sections.text: {back to D minor, the strutting duel hook at full power; the last bar is a snare fill on the dominant that leads straight back into the hook}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
